about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_brief.py). bad replays the pilot read-missing class of references/target-class.json: it throws the real File not found line for the missing lead brief. good writes or reads the brief first, gates the dispatch on the brief file, and prints the gated report it promises.

fixture.brief.md:
goal: gate every pilot dispatch on a written brief
scope: owner/name lead brief plus 12 trial tasks
proof: gated report with brief plus approval plus dispatch
stop: no dispatch on a missing vague or oral brief
fixture.lead.md: lead brief body with the written plan
fixture.plan.txt: plan: write the brief, gate the dispatch, report PASS

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name lead2.md dispatched with no brief on disk'
pairs.good: $b = Get-Content -LiteralPath brief.md -Raw; 'brief plan PASS written first'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name dispatch started with no brief to gate on'
pairs.expect: brief gate PASS held then released
pairs.good: $b = Get-Content -LiteralPath brief.md -Raw; 'brief gate PASS held then released'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name one-line brief sent the pilot at the wrong file'
pairs.expect: brief sections PASS goal scope proof stop
pairs.good: $b = Get-Content -LiteralPath brief.md -Raw; 'brief sections PASS goal scope proof stop'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name assumed brief present before dispatch'
pairs.good: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath brief.md) { 'brief verify PASS exists dispatched' } else { throw 'missing brief file' }

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name oral handoff left the pilot reading missing files'
pairs.good: $b = Get-Content -LiteralPath brief.md -Raw; 'brief handoff PASS written filed'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name dispatch skipped approval on stale paths'
pairs.good: $b = Get-Content -LiteralPath brief.md -Raw; 'brief approval PASS approved released'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name pilot opened with no written plan'
pairs.good: $p = Get-Content -LiteralPath plan.txt -Raw; 'brief plan PASS dispatched written'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name build requested with no brief file'
pairs.good: $b = Get-Content -LiteralPath brief.md -Raw; 'brief gate PASS build released'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name handoff arrived with no shaped sections'
pairs.expect: brief sections PASS shaped goal scope proof stop
pairs.good: $b = Get-Content -LiteralPath brief.md -Raw; 'brief sections PASS shaped goal scope proof stop'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name queued dispatch read before any check'
pairs.good: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath brief.md) { 'brief verify PASS checked dispatched' } else { throw 'missing brief file' }

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name cross-repo task opened with no brief file'
pairs.good: $b = Get-Content -LiteralPath brief.md -Raw; 'brief handoff PASS filed written'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name second wave planned with no approved brief'
pairs.good: $b = Get-Content -LiteralPath brief.md -Raw; 'RESULT brief PASS approval recorded'
